About Me

I specialize in Systems Analysis with over 20 years of experience in software development, system analysis, platform integration and problem solving.

My expertise includes observability and support skills, AWS, REST/SOAP APIs, Salesforce and System Development (Java, Node.js, Python, Go and .NET).

I am proud to lead teams and deliver robust technological solutions, prioritizing operational efficiency, innovation and measurable results. SRE certified, with expertise in Data Science, Business Agility and AWS, I combine technical knowledge and strategic vision to manage complex projects.

In addition, I stress the creation of collaborative environments and the positive impact on teams and organizations. I love challenges where I can combine technical expertise, business vision and agile practices to achieve transformative results.
